exposure: Mode of delivery of the second twin
cohort: 227 second twins born to mothers who attempted vaginal delivery
finding: Adverse long-term outcomes (mortality and neurodevelopmental disorders) were uncommon among second twins born to mothers who attempted vaginal delivery, and were associated with prematurity and inter-twin delivery interval of more than 30 minutes, but not with the actual mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Second twins in the combined vaginal-cesarean birth group had no significant increase in adverse outcomes compared to those in the vaginal-vaginal birth group.
